service.advanced.asIs.description: Why advanced.json can't be used, in English (kept from before Combwork translated it). Keep it as {problem} alone.

service.advanced.changedOutside.defaultMessage: advanced.json was changed outside Combwork meanwhile: Settings shows it now. Try again.
service.advanced.changedOutside.description: An error changing an advanced setting: advanced.json (a file name: keep it) was edited elsewhere meanwhile, so the change wasn't written.

service.advanced.fixFirst.defaultMessage: {problem} Fix advanced.json (Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json) before changing settings here.
service.advanced.fixFirst.description: An error changing an advanced setting while advanced.json (a file name: keep it) can't be read; {problem} says why, a sentence. Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json is where to open it: use its translated names.

service.advanced.fixOrDelete.defaultMessage: {problem} Fix or delete advanced.json first (Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json).
service.advanced.fixOrDelete.description: An error resetting every advanced setting while advanced.json (a file name: keep it) can't be read; {problem} says why, a sentence. Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json is where to open it: use its translated names.

service.advanced.newer.defaultMessage: advanced.json is from a newer Combwork (format {format}): this one reads format {supported}.
service.advanced.newer.description: Above Settings → Advanced's list: advanced.json (a file name: keep it) was written by a newer version of Combwork, in a format ({format}) this one can't read ({supported} is the one it reads).

service.advanced.notJson.description: Above Settings → Advanced's list: Combwork's advanced settings file (advanced.json, a file name: keep it) can't be read as JSON; {error} is the JSON reader's own words (English, with no full stop of its own). A sentence of its own: more follows it.

service.advanced.notObject.description: Above Settings → Advanced's list: advanced.json (a file name: keep it) holds JSON that isn't an object; {example} is what it should look like (JSON: keep it).

service.advanced.notValues.defaultMessage: advanced.json's "values" should be an object of setting → value.
service.advanced.notValues.description: Above Settings → Advanced's list: the "values" field of advanced.json (keep both as they are) isn't a set of settings and their values.

service.advanced.unknown.description: An error changing an advanced setting: Combwork has none with the id {id}.

service.answerRelay.title.description: A notification's title (a banner, a Windows notification): the user answered an agent's question on card {card} (its key, such as HI-12), and the Combwork Assistant, which could act on it, couldn't be told.

service.assistantAsk.title.defaultMessage: {card}: the Assistant didn't get an agent's request
service.assistantAsk.title.description: A notification's title (a banner, a Windows notification), HI-1866: an agent asked the Combwork Assistant for something on card {card} (its key, such as HI-12), and the request couldn't reach the Assistant.

service.attachments.badFolder.description: An error: a name given for a session's attachments folder isn't one Combwork makes (a session id).

service.attachments.badRecord.defaultMessage: {file} is not a record of moved files
service.attachments.badRecord.description: An error: the file {file} where Combwork records attachments it renamed can't be read as one (damaged).

service.attachments.notOwn.defaultMessage: {folder} is a link or not a folder of the project's own, so Combwork keeps no attachments in it.
service.attachments.notOwn.description: An error keeping a pasted or dropped file for a session: its folder {folder} (in the project's .combwork) is a link or leads elsewhere, so Combwork writes nothing through it.

service.benchmarks.allPinned.defaultMessage: {n} are kept and all are pinned: unpin or remove one first.
service.benchmarks.allPinned.description: An error keeping a comparison on the Performance page: the most that can be kept ({n}) are kept, all pinned, so none can make room.

service.benchmarks.cantRead.defaultMessage: The kept comparisons can’t be read: {error}
service.benchmarks.cantRead.description: An error on the Performance page: the list of kept comparisons (benchmarks kept to compare) can't be read; {error} is why (the system's words).

service.benchmarks.closed.defaultMessage: The workspace was closed or switched: nothing was changed.
service.benchmarks.closed.description: An error on the Performance page: the workspace closed, or another opened in its window, while kept comparisons were being changed; nothing changed.

service.benchmarks.damaged.defaultMessage: That comparison file is missing or damaged: remove it and import it again.
service.benchmarks.damaged.description: An error on the Performance page: a kept comparison's file can't be read.

service.benchmarks.evictedStays.defaultMessage: An evicted comparison couldn’t be removed yet: Combwork will try again.
service.benchmarks.evictedStays.description: A note on the Performance page: an old comparison taken off the list to make room couldn't be deleted yet; Combwork tries again later.

service.benchmarks.fileGone.defaultMessage: A kept comparison’s file was gone: it was taken off the list.
service.benchmarks.fileGone.description: A note on the Performance page: a kept comparison's file was missing, so it is no longer listed.

service.benchmarks.invalid.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# file that couldn’t be read was moved to quarantine/.} other {# files that couldn’t be read were moved to quarantine/.}}
service.benchmarks.invalid.description: A note on the Performance page: kept comparison files that couldn't be read were moved to the quarantine/ folder (a folder name: keep it).

service.benchmarks.noFile.description: An error importing a comparison on the Performance page: no file was given.

service.benchmarks.noSuch.description: An error on the Performance page: the kept comparison asked for is not there.

service.benchmarks.noSuchHere.defaultMessage: No such comparison for this scope
service.benchmarks.noSuchHere.description: An error on the Performance page: the kept comparison asked for isn't one of the scope shown (the workspace, or a project).

service.benchmarks.noWorkspace.description: An error on the Performance page: kept comparisons need a workspace open.

service.benchmarks.notRemoved.defaultMessage: It is off the list, but its file couldn’t be removed yet: Combwork will try again.
service.benchmarks.notRemoved.description: An error removing a kept comparison on the Performance page: it is no longer listed, but its file couldn't be deleted yet.

service.benchmarks.notWaiting.defaultMessage: That file is no longer waiting: import it again.
service.benchmarks.notWaiting.description: An error importing a comparison on the Performance page: the file picked earlier is no longer held for the question that was asked about it.

service.benchmarks.overflow.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# more than can be listed was moved to quarantine/.} other {# more than can be listed were moved to quarantine/.}}
service.benchmarks.overflow.description: A note on the Performance page: kept comparisons past the most that can be listed were moved to the quarantine/ folder (a folder name: keep it).

service.benchmarks.recovered.defaultMessage: Recovered: {reason}. {n, plural, one {# kept comparison is} other {# kept comparisons are}} listed again{setAside, select, yes {; the old list is kept as index.damaged-….json} other {}}
service.benchmarks.recovered.description: A note on the Performance page's Compare after Combwork rebuilt its list of kept comparisons: {reason} says why, {n} how many are listed again; with setAside, the damaged list was kept beside it as index.damaged-….json (a file name: keep it).

service.benchmarks.removalFinished.description: A note on the Performance page: removing a kept comparison was interrupted earlier, and Combwork finished it.

service.benchmarks.strays.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# file not in the list was moved to quarantine/.} other {# files not in the list were moved to quarantine/.}}
service.benchmarks.strays.description: A note on the Performance page: kept comparison files the list had no entry for were moved to the quarantine/ folder (a folder name: keep it).

service.benchmarks.stuck.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# removed comparison’s file couldn’t be deleted yet (in use?): nothing more can be kept until it is.} other {# removed comparisons’ files couldn’t be deleted yet (in use?): nothing more can be kept until they are.}} Combwork retries each time it reads the list.
service.benchmarks.stuck.description: An error keeping a comparison on the Performance page: {n} removed comparisons' files couldn't be deleted yet (another program may have them open), and the list has no room until they are.

service.benchmarks.switched.defaultMessage: The workspace was switched: nothing was kept.
service.benchmarks.switched.description: An error keeping the Performance page's report as a comparison: the window opened another workspace meanwhile.

service.benchmarks.tooLarge.description: An error importing a comparison on the Performance page: the file is larger than {mb} MB.

service.benchmarks.unwritable.defaultMessage: Combwork refused to write a list of kept comparisons it couldn’t read back: nothing was changed.
service.benchmarks.unwritable.description: An error on the Performance page: the list of kept comparisons Combwork was about to write wouldn't read back as valid, so it wasn't written.

service.benchmarks.why.defaultMessage: {why, select, missing {the list of kept comparisons was missing} damaged {the list of kept comparisons was damaged} entry {an entry of the list of kept comparisons was damaged} other {the list of kept comparisons had too many entries}}
service.benchmarks.why.description: Why Combwork rebuilt the list of kept comparisons from their files: it was missing, damaged, had a damaged entry, or had too many entries. A clause, lower case (it follows "Recovered:").

service.benchmarks.wrongScope.defaultMessage: That comparison file doesn’t match its scope: remove it and import it again.
service.benchmarks.wrongScope.description: An error on the Performance page: a kept comparison's file is of another scope than its entry in the list says.

service.cardAttach.moveFailed.defaultMessage: The card's attachments couldn't be copied to {project}, so it wasn't moved: {why}
service.cardAttach.moveFailed.description: An error moving a card to another project (HI-1700): its attached files couldn't be copied there; the card stays where it was. {project} is the project's name, {why} the reason.

service.cardAttach.moved.defaultMessage: The card moved to another project meanwhile: attach again.
service.cardAttach.moved.description: An error attaching files to a card (HI-1700): the card moved to another project while they were copied; nothing was attached.

service.cardAttach.noAttachment.defaultMessage: The card has no such attachment.
service.cardAttach.noAttachment.description: An error removing a card attachment (HI-1700) that is gone.

service.cardAttach.noCard.description: An error attaching a file to a card (HI-1700): the card is gone.

service.cardAttach.noProject.defaultMessage: {project} is not a project of the workspace. Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.noProject.description: An error attaching files to a card (HI-1700): the project named for it is not one of the workspace’s (a path, or a name no project has); nothing was copied.

service.cardAttach.refused.defaultMessage: {path} is not a file that can be attached here: give the path of a file of your own project (its folder, its slots) or of the temp folder. Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.refused.description: An error attaching a file to a card by its path (HI-1700): it is missing, a folder or a link, or in a place the caller may not attach from (another project, Combwork’s own folders). Nothing was attached.

service.cardAttach.refusedFrom.defaultMessage: {path} is not a file that can be attached here. Files can come from {caller, select, agent {your own project (its folder, its slots)} other {the workspace and its projects}}, the temp folder ({temp}){more, select, yes { and the folders of Settings → Advanced → Card attachments: more folders ({folders})} other {}}. To attach from another folder, the user adds it there (Settings → Advanced → Card attachments: more folders, Combwork's or this workspace's): don't copy the file into the temp folder. Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.refusedFrom.description: An error attaching a file to a card by its path (HI-1700, HI-2480): it is missing, a folder or a link, or in a place the caller may not attach from. {caller} is agent for a project's agent, else the Assistant or a script; {temp} is the temp folder's path; {more} is yes when the user listed more folders, {folders} those folders. Card attachments: more folders is an advanced setting's title: use it as Settings shows it. Nothing was attached.

service.cardAttach.tooLarge.defaultMessage: {name} is larger than {max}, the most a card keeps in one file (Settings → Advanced → Card attachments: largest file). Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.tooLarge.description: An error attaching files to a card (HI-1700): one is larger than the limit ({max}: a size such as 25 MB); none of them was attached.

service.cardAttach.tooMuch.defaultMessage: At most {files, number} files and {total} can be attached at once. Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.tooMuch.description: An error attaching files to a card (HI-1700): more files, or more bytes in all ({total}: a size such as 100 MB), than one change takes; none was attached.

service.cardCleanup.stale.defaultMessage: This list is out of date: nothing was removed. Open Clean Up Now again.
service.cardCleanup.stale.description: An error of Clean Up Now (Project Settings → Storage, HI-1842): the list of archived cards' files it showed expired, was used already, or belongs to a workspace closed since; nothing was removed.

service.combworkMove.busy.defaultMessage: Another Combwork is moving this workspace's .hive folders to .combwork ({profile}). Open it again once it has finished.
service.combworkMove.busy.description: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): another copy of the app ({profile}: its profile folder's name) is renaming the workspace's .hive folders to .combwork now. Keep .hive and .combwork as they are.

service.combworkMove.closed.defaultMessage: The workspace was closed while Combwork was moving its .hive folders to .combwork. Open it again to finish.
service.combworkMove.closed.description: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): it was closed, or another was opened in its window, during the rename of its .hive folders to .combwork. Keep .hive and .combwork as they are.

service.combworkMove.locked.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't move {folder} to .combwork: a program has a file in it open. Close that program (or the other Combwork or Hive using this workspace), then open the workspace again. Nothing was lost.
service.combworkMove.locked.description: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): its .hive folder, renamed .combwork in this version, couldn't be renamed because a file in it is open. {folder} is the folder. Keep .hive and .combwork as they are (folder names).

service.combworkMove.otherOpen.defaultMessage: This workspace is open in another Combwork or Hive ({profile}). Close it there, then open it here: Combwork moves its .hive folders to .combwork first.
service.combworkMove.otherOpen.description: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): another copy of the app ({profile}: its profile folder's name) has it open, so its .hive folders can't be renamed .combwork now. Keep .hive and .combwork as they are.

service.combworkMove.phaseFailed.defaultMessage: Combwork moved this workspace's .hive folders to .combwork, but couldn't finish updating {what}: {error} Open the workspace again to finish.
service.combworkMove.phaseFailed.description: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): its .hive folders were renamed .combwork, but a step after that failed; the next open finishes it. {what} is what it was updating (main.hiveMove.what.*); {error} says why, a sentence. Keep .hive and .combwork as they are.

service.combworkVcs.cantList.defaultMessage: Git couldn't list the files it tracks in .combwork.
service.combworkVcs.cantList.description: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder from git: git couldn't list them. Keep .combwork as it is (a folder name).

service.combworkVcs.cantListWhy.defaultMessage: Git couldn't list the files it tracks in .combwork ({problem}).
service.combworkVcs.cantListWhy.description: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder from git: git can't run; {problem} says why ("Git isn't installed"). Keep .combwork as it is (a folder name).

service.combworkVcs.changed.defaultMessage: The files git tracks in .combwork changed since you were shown them: nothing was untracked. Look again.
service.combworkVcs.changed.description: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder from git: the list of its tracked files changed after Combwork showed it, so nothing changed. Keep .combwork as it is.

service.combworkVcs.exitCode.description: Why a git command failed when git said nothing: the number it exited with.

service.combworkVcs.noRepo.defaultMessage: No git repository holds this project.
service.combworkVcs.noRepo.description: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder (Combwork's own files) from git: the project isn't in a git repository.

service.combworkVcs.rmFailed.description: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder from git: the git command (git rm --cached: keep it) failed; {why} is git's own first line, or why git can't run.

service.files.badName.description: An error making or renaming a file or folder: {name} is empty, . or .., or has a character Windows can't have in a name.

service.files.exists.description: An error making or renaming a file or folder in the Files tab: one called {name} is already there.

service.files.existsIn.defaultMessage: {root, select, yes {"{name}" already exists in the project root} other {"{name}" already exists in {folder}}}
service.files.existsIn.description: An error moving files: the folder they go to already has one called {name}. {root} is yes when that folder is the project's own (its root), else {folder} is its path in the project.

service.files.groupInUse.defaultMessage: Another program has one of these files open. Close it, then try again.
service.files.groupInUse.description: An error deleting a session's attachments: another program has one of them open, so none was moved.

service.files.inUse.defaultMessage: Another program has this file open. Close it, then try again.
service.files.inUse.description: An error deleting a session's attachment: another program has the file open, so Windows won't move it.

service.files.insideItself.description: An error moving a folder ({name}) into itself, or into a folder inside it.

service.files.nameRequired.description: An error making a file or folder with no name.

service.files.needsEntry.defaultMessage: This action needs a file or folder inside the project
service.files.needsEntry.description: An error in the Files tab: the action (rename, move, delete…) was given the project's own folder, not something in it.

service.files.notAttachment.description: An error opening or deleting a session's attachment: the path isn't a file in a session's attachments folder.

service.files.notKept.defaultMessage: Not one of the session attachments Combwork keeps.
service.files.notKept.description: An error deleting a session's attachment (a file pasted or dropped into a session): it isn't one Combwork keeps, or it is a link.

service.files.outside.description: An error in the Files tab: a file's path leads out of the project.

service.files.throughLink.defaultMessage: Path leads outside the project (through a link)
service.files.throughLink.description: An error in the Files tab: a file's path goes through a link (a symbolic link or junction) to somewhere outside the project.

service.fsutil.keptBusy.defaultMessage: {file} is being saved by something else: nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
service.fsutil.keptBusy.description: An error: one of Combwork's settings or records files ({file}: its path) was still being written by another program (an editor, a script), so Combwork's change to it wasn't made.

service.fsutil.keptUnreadable.defaultMessage: {file} couldn't be read: nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
service.fsutil.keptUnreadable.description: An error: one of Combwork's settings or records files ({file}: its path) is there but couldn't be read (another program had it locked, or a disk error), so Combwork's change to it wasn't made and the file was left as it is.

service.fsutil.notCopied.description: An error putting back one of Combwork's skills or modes: its copy couldn't be made ({name}: its folder or file name); nothing was replaced.

service.git.exitCode.description: Why a git command failed when git said nothing: the number it exited with.

service.git.failed.description: An error in the Changes tab: a git command ({command}, as it is: "git status") failed; {why} is git's own first line, or why git can't run.

service.git.outside.description: An error showing a file's changes: its path leads out of the project.

service.git.tooLarge.defaultMessage: File is too large to diff ({kb, number} KB).
service.git.tooLarge.description: Shown in place of a file's changes in the Changes tab: the file is too large ({kb} KB) to compare.

service.gitCompare.noBranch.defaultMessage: There's no branch {branch} here any more.
service.gitCompare.noBranch.description: An error comparing two branches in the Changes tab: the branch {branch} was deleted or renamed since the list was read.

service.gitRepo.addFailed.description: An error adding the remote {remote} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.added.description: After adding a remote in the Git view: {remote} is its name.

service.gitRepo.alreadyOn.description: After switching branch in the Git view: the project folder was on {branch} already.

service.gitRepo.badName.defaultMessage: {kind, select, tag {{hasName, select, yes {{name} isn't a valid tag name.} other {That isn't a valid tag name.}}} other {{hasName, select, yes {{name} isn't a valid branch name.} other {That isn't a valid branch name.}}}}
service.gitRepo.badName.description: An error creating a branch or a tag ({kind}): its name {name} is one git refuses. {hasName} is no when no name was given (then it says That).

service.gitRepo.branchKept.defaultMessage: {why, select, target {{branch} is the branch work merges into: kept.} default {{branch} is the default branch: kept.} current {{branch} is checked out in the project folder: kept.} worktree {{branch} is checked out in a worktree or slot: kept.} card {An open card works on {branch}: kept.} remoteHead {{branch} is the remote's default branch: kept.} moved {{branch} has moved since you were shown it: kept. Look at it again.} unmerged {{branch} has commits that aren't in {target}: kept.} gone {There's no branch {branch}.} other {{branch} isn't a valid branch name.}}
service.gitRepo.branchKept.description: Why a branch wasn't deleted (Clean Up Merged Branches, Delete branch…, in Version Control → Branches & remotes). {branch} is its name, {target} the branch the project's work merges into. Keep the select keys.

service.gitRepo.branchesDeleted.description: After deleting branches in Version Control → Branches & remotes: {branches} lists them ({n}).

service.gitRepo.chooseRemote.defaultMessage: Choose the remote to push to.
service.gitRepo.chooseRemote.description: An error pushing in the Git view: the repository has several remotes and none was chosen.

service.gitRepo.command.description: An error in the Git view: a git command ({command}, as it is: "git log") failed; {why} is git's own words, or why git can't run.

service.gitRepo.createFailed.description: An error creating the branch or tag {name}; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.createdAt.description: After creating a branch in the Git view without switching to it: {name} starts at the commit {commit} (a short hash).

service.gitRepo.createdSwitched.description: After creating a branch in the Git view: the project folder is on the new branch {name}.

service.gitRepo.deleteBranchFailed.description: An error deleting the branch {branch} in Version Control → Branches & remotes; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.detachedPull.defaultMessage: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch to pull.
service.gitRepo.detachedPull.description: An error pulling in the Git view: the project folder is on no branch (a detached HEAD: keep HEAD as it is).

service.gitRepo.detachedPush.defaultMessage: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch to push.
service.gitRepo.detachedPush.description: An error pushing in the Git view: the project folder is on no branch (a detached HEAD: keep HEAD as it is).

service.gitRepo.diverged.defaultMessage: {branch} and {upstream} have diverged ({ahead, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} here, {behind, number} there), so pulling needs a merge or rebase. Do that in a terminal, or ask an agent to.
service.gitRepo.diverged.description: An error pulling in the Git view: the branch {branch} has {ahead} commits the remote branch {upstream} hasn't, and it has {behind} the branch hasn't; Combwork pulls only when no merge is needed.

service.gitRepo.exitCode.description: Why a git command failed when git said nothing: the number it exited with.

service.gitRepo.fetchFailed.description: An error fetching from the repository's remotes; {why} is git's own words (any password in a URL hidden).

service.gitRepo.fetched.description: After fetching in the Git view: {remotes} lists the remotes fetched from (their names), in the language's way.

service.gitRepo.gaveUp.defaultMessage: git gave up after {minutes} minutes (no answer from the remote, or a sign-in left open).
service.gitRepo.gaveUp.description: Why fetching, pulling or pushing failed: git waited {minutes} minutes for the remote (or a sign-in window) and stopped.

service.gitRepo.identityRemoved.defaultMessage: Removed this repository's own identity: your global one applies.
service.gitRepo.identityRemoved.description: After clearing the repository's own commit name and email in the Git view: git uses the user's global ones.

service.gitRepo.identitySet.description: After setting the repository's own commit name and email in the Git view.

service.gitRepo.inWorktree.defaultMessage: {branch} is checked out in another worktree ({folder}): a branch can be in only one folder at a time.
service.gitRepo.inWorktree.description: An error switching branch in the Git view: the branch {branch} is checked out in the worktree {folder}.

service.gitRepo.midOperation.defaultMessage: Git is in the middle of a {state}: finish or abort it first.
service.gitRepo.midOperation.description: An error pulling in the Git view: a git operation is under way in the project folder; {state} is git's word for it (merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert or bisect: keep it as it is).

service.gitRepo.noBranch.description: An error in the Git view (switching branch, choosing what a branch tracks): the repository has no branch called {branch}.

service.gitRepo.noCommits.defaultMessage: The repository has no commits yet: commit something first.
service.gitRepo.noCommits.description: An error creating a branch in a repository with no commit yet.

service.gitRepo.noRemote.description: An error pushing or tagging: the repository has no remote called {remote}.

service.gitRepo.noRemotes.defaultMessage: This repository has no remotes: add one first.
service.gitRepo.noRemotes.description: An error pushing in the Git view: the repository has no remote.

service.gitRepo.noRemotesFetch.defaultMessage: This repository has no remotes to fetch from: add one first.
service.gitRepo.noRemotesFetch.description: An error fetching in the Git view: the repository has no remote.

service.gitRepo.noTarget.defaultMessage: There's no branch {target} here to check the branches against.
service.gitRepo.noTarget.description: An error deleting branches in Version Control → Branches & remotes: the branch the project's work merges into ({target}; the default branch when none is set) isn't in the repository, so Combwork can't tell which branches are merged.

service.gitRepo.noUpstream.defaultMessage: {branch} tracks no remote branch: push it first, or switch to one that does.
service.gitRepo.noUpstream.description: An error pulling in the Git view: the branch {branch} follows no remote branch.

service.gitRepo.notOnRemote.defaultMessage: {remote} has no {branch} (as of the last fetch): push it there first, or fetch.
service.gitRepo.notOnRemote.description: An error choosing what a branch tracks in the Git view: the remote {remote} has no branch {branch} that Combwork knows of.

service.gitRepo.notRepo.description: An error in the Git view: the project folder {folder} is not in a git repository.

service.gitRepo.nothingToPush.defaultMessage: The repository has no commits yet: nothing to push.
service.gitRepo.nothingToPush.description: An error pushing in the Git view: the repository has no commit yet.

service.gitRepo.nothingToTag.defaultMessage: The repository has no commits yet: nothing to tag.
service.gitRepo.nothingToTag.description: An error tagging in the Git view: the repository has no commit yet.

service.gitRepo.pullFailed.description: An error pulling in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.pulled.defaultMessage: Pulled {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} from {upstream}.
service.gitRepo.pulled.description: After pulling in the Git view: {n} commits came from the remote branch {upstream}.

service.gitRepo.pushAllRefused.defaultMessage: {remote} refused {n, plural, one {# branch or tag} other {# branches and tags}} (Combwork never forces a push): it has commits they haven't, so pull or merge them first. What happened to each:
service.gitRepo.pushAllRefused.description: An error after Push to… with all branches and tags in the Git view: the first line, the remote {remote} refused {n} of them; a line for each outcome follows (service.gitRepo.pushOutcome).

service.gitRepo.pushFailed.description: An error pushing to the remote branch {to} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.pushOutcome.defaultMessage: {result, select, pushed {Pushed: {refs}.} upToDate {Already up to date: {refs}.} refused {Refused: {refs}.} other {Tags pushed: {refs}.}}
service.gitRepo.pushOutcome.description: A line after Push to… with all branches and tags in the Git view: the branches pushed, already up to date, refused (branches or tags), or the tags pushed. {refs} lists them all by name.

service.gitRepo.pushUpToDate.description: After Push to… in the Git view: the remote branch {to} already had every commit of the branch {branch}.

service.gitRepo.pushed.description: After pushing in the Git view: the branch {branch} went to the remote branch {to}.

service.gitRepo.pushedAll.defaultMessage: Pushed every branch and tag to {remote}:
service.gitRepo.pushedAll.description: After Push to… with all branches and tags in the Git view: the first line, what went to the remote {remote}; a line for each outcome follows (service.gitRepo.pushOutcome).

service.gitRepo.rejected.defaultMessage: {to} has commits {branch} hasn't, so the push was refused (Combwork never forces a push). Pull first, or merge them in a terminal.
service.gitRepo.rejected.description: An error pushing the branch {branch} in the Git view: the remote branch {to} has commits it hasn't, so the remote refused.

service.gitRepo.remoteBranchesDeleted.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Deleted {branches} on {remote}.} other {Deleted # branches on {remote}: {branches}.}}
service.gitRepo.remoteBranchesDeleted.description: After deleting branches on the remote {remote} (Clean Up Merged Branches): {branches} lists them ({n}).

service.gitRepo.remoteDeleteRefused.defaultMessage: {remote} refused to delete {branches}: it has commits there you haven't fetched, or it doesn't allow deleting them.
service.gitRepo.remoteDeleteRefused.description: After deleting branches on the remote {remote}: it refused those listed in {branches} (Combwork deletes a remote branch only at the commit you were shown).

service.gitRepo.remoteRemoved.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {Removed {remote}.} one {Removed {remote}: {branches} no longer tracks a remote branch.} other {Removed {remote}: {branches} no longer track a remote branch.}}
service.gitRepo.remoteRemoved.description: After removing the remote {remote} in the Git view. {branches} lists the local branches that tracked it ({n} of them).

service.gitRepo.remoteRenamed.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {Renamed {from} to {to}.} one {Renamed {from} to {to}: {branches} tracks it by its new name.} other {Renamed {from} to {to}: {branches} track it by its new name.}}
service.gitRepo.remoteRenamed.description: After renaming a remote in the Git view from {from} to {to}. {branches} lists the local branches tracking it ({n} of them), which follow the rename.

service.gitRepo.remoteSameName.description: After Rename in the Git view, when the remote {remote} was given its own name.

service.gitRepo.remoteTaken.defaultMessage: There is a remote called {remote} already.
service.gitRepo.remoteTaken.description: An error renaming a remote in the Git view: another remote has that name ({remote}).

service.gitRepo.remoteTrackingChanged.defaultMessage: The branches tracking {remote} changed since you were asked, so nothing was removed: look at them again.
service.gitRepo.remoteTrackingChanged.description: An error removing a remote in the Git view: the local branches tracking it are not the ones the confirmation listed (one started or stopped tracking it meanwhile).

service.gitRepo.removeRemoteFailed.description: An error removing the remote {remote} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.renameRemoteFailed.description: An error renaming the remote {remote} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.setFailed.description: An error setting the repository's commit identity in the Git view: the git setting {key} (user.name or user.email: keep it) couldn't be set; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.switchFailed.description: An error switching the project folder to the branch {branch}; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.switched.description: After switching branch in the Git view: the project folder is on {branch} now.

service.gitRepo.switchedTracking.description: After switching to a remote branch in the Git view: a new local branch {branch} was made, following the remote branch {remote} (origin/x).

service.gitRepo.tagPushFailed.defaultMessage: Tagged {commit} {name}, but couldn't push it to {remote}: {why}
service.gitRepo.tagPushFailed.description: An error in the Git view: the commit {commit} was tagged {name}, but pushing the tag to the remote {remote} failed; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.tagged.description: After tagging in the Git view: the commit {commit} (a short hash) has the tag {name}.

service.gitRepo.taggedPushed.description: After tagging in the Git view: the commit {commit} has the tag {name}, which went to the remote {remote} too.

service.gitRepo.trackedNothing.description: After Stop tracking in the Git view, when the branch {branch} tracked nothing.

service.gitRepo.tracking.defaultMessage: {pushed, select, yes {Pushed {branch} to {upstream}, and it tracks it now.} other {{branch} tracks {upstream} now.}}
service.gitRepo.tracking.description: After Track… in the Git view: the branch {branch} follows the remote branch {upstream} (pushed there first when {pushed} is yes).

service.gitRepo.untracked.description: After Stop tracking in the Git view: the branch {branch} no longer follows the remote branch {upstream}.

service.gitRepo.upToDate.description: After pulling in the Git view: the branch {branch} has every commit of the remote branch {upstream} already.

service.gitRepo.update.agentBusy.defaultMessage: {agent} {status, select, starting {is starting} working {is working} waiting {is waiting for your answer} background {is waiting on background tasks it started} watching {is waiting for cards to change (a card watch)} other {stopped in the middle of a task when its sign-in expired}} in {folder}: update {branch} once it has finished.
service.gitRepo.update.agentBusy.description: Why updating a branch from its target is refused now: an agent works in the folder the branch is checked out in ({folder}: a slot's name, such as slot-a, or a folder's name or path). {agent} is the agent's name; {status} what it is doing (select: translate each); {branch} the branch.

service.gitRepo.update.conflict.defaultMessage: {how, select, rebase {Rebasing} other {Merging}} {branch} with {target} stopped at a conflict in {files}, so it was undone: {branch} is as it was. Update it by hand, or ask its builder to.
service.gitRepo.update.conflict.description: An error updating a branch from its target: git stopped at a conflict, and Combwork aborted it, leaving the branch and its folder as they were. {how}: merge or rebase (select: translate each); {branch} the branch, {target} the target; {files} the files in conflict, joined (src/a.ts and src/b.ts).

service.gitRepo.update.dirty.defaultMessage: {folder} has uncommitted changes: commit them, or set them aside, before updating {branch}.
service.gitRepo.update.dirty.description: Why updating a branch from its target is refused: the folder it is checked out in ({folder}: a slot's name, a folder's name or a path) has changes not committed. {branch} is the branch.

service.gitRepo.update.failed.defaultMessage: Couldn't update {branch} from {target}, so it is as it was: {why}
service.gitRepo.update.failed.description: An error updating a branch from its target that isn't a conflict (a hook refused the commit, signing failed…); Combwork undid what git started. {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.update.forwarded.description: After Update from <target> on a branch with no commits of its own (HI-1180): it was moved forward to the target {target}; {commit} is its new head (a short id: keep it as it is).

service.gitRepo.update.isTarget.description: An error updating a branch from its target: the branch picked ({branch}) is the target.

service.gitRepo.update.merged.description: After Update from <target> with Merge (HI-1180): the target {target} was merged into the branch {branch}, as the commit {commit} (a short id: keep it as it is).

service.gitRepo.update.midOperation.defaultMessage: Git is in the middle of a {state} in {folder}: finish or abort it first.
service.gitRepo.update.midOperation.description: Why updating a branch from its target is refused: a git operation ({state}: merge, rebase…, as git names it) is under way in the folder the branch is checked out in ({folder}: a slot's name, a folder's name or a path).

service.gitRepo.update.missed.defaultMessage: {branch} was changed, but it still lacks commits of {target}: check it in History before going on.
service.gitRepo.update.missed.description: An error after Update from <target> (HI-1180): git said it succeeded, but the branch {branch} still doesn't contain the target {target}'s head.

service.gitRepo.update.moved.defaultMessage: {branch} changed while it was being updated, so nothing was changed: try again.
service.gitRepo.update.moved.description: An error updating a branch from its target: the branch moved to another commit meanwhile (a commit, a push), so Combwork left it as it is.

service.gitRepo.update.noTarget.defaultMessage: The project has no target branch here, so there is nothing to update {branch} from.
service.gitRepo.update.noTarget.description: An error updating a branch from its target (Version Control → Branches, HI-1180): the project's workflow target (or the repository's default branch) doesn't exist in this repository. {branch} is the branch.

service.gitRepo.update.notUndone.defaultMessage: Updating {branch} from {target} stopped, and Combwork couldn't undo it: {folder} is {state, select, none {left changed} merge {still in the middle of a merge} rebase {still in the middle of a rebase} other {still in the middle of a git operation}}. Finish or abort it there yourself (git status says how), then check {branch}. Git said: {why}
service.gitRepo.update.notUndone.description: An error updating a branch from its target (HI-1180): git stopped, and Combwork's own abort failed, so the folder ({folder}: a slot's name, a folder's name or a path) is left as git left it ({state}: none, merge, rebase or another operation; select: translate each). {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.update.notUndoneTemporar.defaultMessage: Updating {branch} from {target} stopped, and Combwork couldn't undo it in its temporary folder {folder}, kept as git left it: {branch} itself is as it was. Remove that folder in Unused worktrees once you have looked. Git said: {why}
service.gitRepo.update.notUndoneTemporar.description: An error updating a branch from its target (HI-1180) that was checked out nowhere: git stopped in the temporary folder Combwork made ({folder}: its path), and Combwork's abort failed, so the folder is kept; the branch itself wasn't moved. {state} is unused here. {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.update.queued.defaultMessage: {card} is in the merge queue, which brings it up to date itself: take it out of the queue first to update {branch} here.
service.gitRepo.update.queued.description: Why updating a branch from its target is refused: the branch is the line of a card ({card}: its key, such as HI-12) that Combwork's merge queue is merging now. {branch} is the branch.

service.gitRepo.update.rebased.defaultMessage: Rebased {branch}'s {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} onto {target} ({commit}).
service.gitRepo.update.rebased.description: After Update from <target> with Rebase (HI-1180): the branch {branch} has its {n} commits replayed onto the target {target}; {commit} is its new head (a short id: keep it as it is).

service.gitRepo.update.temporaryLeft.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't remove its temporary folder {folder}: remove it in Unused worktrees.
service.gitRepo.update.temporaryLeft.description: A second line after Update from <target> on a branch checked out nowhere (HI-1180): the temporary folder Combwork made for it ({folder}: its path) could not be removed.

service.gitRepo.update.upToDate.description: After Update from <target> (HI-1180): the branch {branch} already contains every commit of the target {target}; nothing was done.

service.gitRepo.upstreamGone.description: An error pulling in the Git view: the remote branch {upstream} the branch follows was deleted there.

service.gitRepo.urlChanged.description: After changing the address of the remote {remote} in the Git view.

service.gitRepo.urlFailed.description: An error changing the address of the remote {remote} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.intent.noWorkflow.defaultMessage: {card} has no workflow: it is a card about the workspace, or its project has no version control chosen yet. Move it on the board instead.
service.intent.noWorkflow.description: An error: an intent (a card's start, submission, verdict…) was asked for a card that has no workflow, because it belongs to no project or its project's version control (Git or None) isn't chosen yet. {card} is the card's key (HI-12).

service.intent.queueNotAgents.defaultMessage: Only the user, or the Assistant within Settings → Assistant → Control, takes a card out of the merge queue or retries its merge.
service.intent.queueNotAgents.description: An error: an agent or a script asked to remove a card from the merge queue or retry its merge, which only the user and the Combwork Assistant (within its Control setting, a setting name: use it as Combwork shows it) can do.

service.keys.closed.defaultMessage: The workspace was closed, or the window opened another, before the key was changed: nothing changed.
service.keys.closed.description: An error changing a project's key: its workspace closed (or the window switched to another workspace) while the change waited; nothing was changed.

service.keys.form.defaultMessage: A project key is 2 to 4 letters, A to Z.
service.keys.form.description: An error changing a project's key (Project Settings): the key typed isn't 2–4 letters A–Z.

service.keys.notice.defaultMessage: Cards are named by their project’s key: {keys}. Change a key in Project Settings; the old one keeps working.
service.keys.notice.description: A quiet notice once after the upgrade to Hive 1.0. {keys}: the projects' keys, joined (HI, AM and WE).

service.keys.noticeTitle.description: A quiet notice's title, once after the upgrade to Hive 1.0: each project now has a short key (letters such as HI or AM) its cards are named by (HI-12).

service.keys.prefix.defaultMessage: {key} and another project’s key {other} begin alike: no key can be the start of another.
service.keys.prefix.description: An error changing a project's key: {key} and another project's key {other} (both letters such as AM and AMB) would be one the start of the other, which isn't allowed.

service.keys.taken.defaultMessage: {key} is another project’s key, or was: a key stays with its project for good.
service.keys.taken.description: An error changing a project's key: {key} (letters such as AM) belongs to another project now or did before (its old keys stay its aliases).

service.keys.unknownProject.defaultMessage: That project has no id yet, so it can’t have a key: open it in Combwork first.
service.keys.unknownProject.description: An error changing a project's key: the project hasn't been given Combwork's id (it hasn't been opened yet).

service.laneStart.busy.defaultMessage: {status, select, working {Agent {agent} is working.} starting {Agent {agent} is starting.} waiting {Agent {agent} is waiting for your answer.} background {Agent {agent} is waiting on background tasks it started.} signin {Agent {agent} needs you to sign in again.} other {Agent {agent} is waiting on cards (a card watch).}} Start the lane once it's idle, or choose another agent.
service.laneStart.busy.description: An error starting a lane from the window: the agent {agent} can't start in a new conversation now, because of what it is doing ({status}; keep the select keys). The window offers to wait until it's idle. Each {status} a whole sentence with a noun before the name (HI-1585: glossary §1 rules 3 and 4).

service.laneStart.done.description: An error starting a lane from the window: a card chosen ({card}, its key) is already Done.

service.laneStart.needsReviewer.defaultMessage: {project}'s rules have a reviewer agent review each card: choose a reviewer.
service.laneStart.needsReviewer.description: An error starting a lane from the window: the project's workflow options have a reviewer agent review the work, and no reviewer was chosen.

service.laneStart.noCards.defaultMessage: Choose the cards for the lane.
service.laneStart.noCards.description: An error starting a lane (a builder and a reviewer working through cards in turn) from the window: no card was chosen.

service.laneStart.notTheProjects.defaultMessage: {card} isn't one of {project}'s cards, or it is archived.
service.laneStart.notTheProjects.description: An error starting a lane from the window: a card chosen ({card}, its key) isn't this project's ({project}), or is archived.

service.laneStart.poolEmpty.defaultMessage: None of {project}'s agents besides the builder reviews, so the pool has nobody to review the cards.
service.laneStart.poolEmpty.description: An error starting a lane from the window with the reviewer pool chosen: no agent of the project other than the builder has a role that reviews (Reviewer or Either).

service.laneStart.poolNotOffered.defaultMessage: {project}'s rules have one reviewer per lane: choose a reviewer, or set Reviewers to a shared pool.
service.laneStart.poolNotOffered.description: An error starting a lane from the window with the reviewer pool chosen: the project's workflow options (G17, “Reviewers”, a value “A shared pool”) don't have a pool, or workflow rules are off.

service.laneStart.sameAgent.defaultMessage: The builder can't be its own reviewer.
service.laneStart.sameAgent.description: An error starting a lane from the window: the same agent was chosen as builder and reviewer.

service.laneStart.starting.defaultMessage: The lane of agent {agent} is being started already.
service.laneStart.starting.description: An error starting a lane from the window: one with the same builder ({agent}) is being started right now. A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

service.laneStart.unknownAgent.description: An error starting a lane from the window: the builder or reviewer chosen ({agent}) isn't an agent of the project ({project}).

service.laneStarts.freshBlockedBody.defaultMessage: {why, select, timeout {It wasn’t free within {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.} uncertain {Combwork closed while starting it, so it may not have started.} other {{reason}}} Retry it from the lane’s row in the Progress panel, or end the lane. Its cards wait until then.
service.laneStarts.freshBlockedBody.description: A notification's text (HI-2034), under "{agent}'s new conversation didn't start". why (select): the agent wasn't free (in a turn) within the wait, {minutes} minutes (Settings → Advanced); Combwork closed while it was starting it; or (other) its start failed, {reason} saying why (a sentence, may be in English). Translate each.

service.laneStarts.freshBlockedTitle.description: A notification's title (HI-2034): a lane's agent ({agent}, its name) is owed a new conversation for the lane, and Combwork has stopped trying to start it.

service.lanes.noWorkspace.description: An error changing a workspace's lanes (card loops) while no workspace is open in the window.

service.lanes.teamPaused.defaultMessage: The team is paused (before an update): resume the team first, then start the lane.
service.lanes.teamPaused.description: An error starting a lane (a card loop) while the user or the Combwork Assistant has paused the whole team before an update (HI-2081): nothing of a lane starts until the team resumes (Resume the Team, in the Progress panel's Lanes).

service.lanes.unknown.description: An error: there is no lane (a card loop) with the id {id}, perhaps removed meanwhile.

service.mcp.addedDropped.defaultMessage: Each project and the Assistant lists the servers that ran there. {n, plural, one {# choice kept for a server that was off in the workspace was} other {# choices kept for servers that were off in the workspace were}} dropped: add a server in a project’s MCP tab where you need it.
service.mcp.addedDropped.description: A quiet notice once after the upgrade that made MCP servers added to projects and the Combwork Assistant: nothing that ran changed; {n} choices remembered for servers the workspace had switched off were not carried over. "MCP tab" as Combwork names it.

service.mcp.addedTitle.defaultMessage: MCP servers are now added where they run
service.mcp.addedTitle.description: A quiet notice's title, once after the upgrade that made a workspace's MCP servers added to projects and the Combwork Assistant, in place of switches.

service.metrics.badProvider.defaultMessage: provider must be a provider id
service.metrics.badProvider.description: An error reading metrics: the provider filter isn't a provider's id. Keep provider as it is (a parameter's name).

service.metrics.badRange.defaultMessage: from and to must be ISO times, from before to
service.metrics.badRange.description: An error reading metrics: the range asked for is not two times in order. from and to are the parameters' names: keep them, and ISO.

service.metrics.badRole.defaultMessage: role must be agent, assistant, api or viewer
service.metrics.badRole.description: An error reading metrics: the role filter isn't one of its values. Keep role, agent, assistant, api and viewer as they are (a parameter and its values).

service.metrics.droppedPerProject.defaultMessage: Dropped measurements are counted per project, not per role or provider.
service.metrics.droppedPerProject.description: A note on the Performance page while it is filtered by role or provider: dropped measurements can't be narrowed.

service.metrics.notCliContext.defaultMessage: Context a CLI adds itself (its own system prompt, tool definitions, files it reads).
service.metrics.notCliContext.description: On the Performance page, under What isn't measured: what a coding agent CLI puts in its model's context itself.

service.metrics.notNetwork.defaultMessage: Provider network traffic: Combwork starts the CLIs; it is not a proxy between them and their providers.
service.metrics.notNetwork.description: On the Performance page, under What isn't measured: the coding agent CLIs' own network traffic.

service.metrics.notPerProvider.defaultMessage: Agent API requests, tool calls and the tool list aren’t recorded per provider: they are every provider’s.
service.metrics.notPerProvider.description: A note on the Performance page while it is filtered by provider: these numbers can't be narrowed to one provider.

service.metrics.notSkillReads.defaultMessage: Whether a model read a skill: delivered skills are counted, reading one is not observable.
service.metrics.notSkillReads.description: On the Performance page, under What isn't measured: whether a model read a skill Combwork gave it.

service.metrics.notTokens.defaultMessage: Provider tokens per Combwork tool or per guidance part: providers report a session’s usage, not what each part of its context cost.
service.metrics.notTokens.description: On the Performance page, under What isn't measured: Combwork can't tell how many tokens each of its tools or guidance parts cost.

service.metrics.notTransport.defaultMessage: HTTP headers and transport: request sizes are the body bytes received, response sizes the JSON body written (an aborted reply may not all have been sent).
service.metrics.notTransport.description: On the Performance page, under What isn't measured: the Agent API's request and response sizes count only the bodies.

service.metrics.sharedNumbers.defaultMessage: The skill service and Combwork-wide numbers are shared: not per role or provider.
service.metrics.sharedNumbers.description: A note on the Performance page while it is filtered by role or provider: these numbers can't be narrowed.

service.providers.keysStopped.defaultMessage: {task}: Combwork stopped typing into it, as {why}. Finish it in the terminal.
service.providers.keysStopped.description: A notification: Combwork stopped typing the keys of a coding agent CLI's task ({task}: "Codex setup") into its terminal; {why} says why (a clause: "its terminal closed").

service.providers.noSetup.description: An error: the coding agent CLI {cli} ("Codex") has no setup task for Combwork to run.

service.providers.notInstalled.description: An error running a coding agent CLI's task (update, sign-in, setup): the CLI {cli} ("Codex") is not installed.

service.providers.pickNotFound.defaultMessage: {task}: Combwork couldn't find {item}. Do it in the terminal, or update Combwork.
service.providers.pickNotFound.description: A notification: Combwork types the keys of a coding agent CLI's task ({task}: "Codex setup") into its terminal, and couldn't find the menu item {item} (the CLI's own words) on its screen.

service.providers.retryUnavailable.defaultMessage: This update retry is no longer available. Check again, then try Update.
service.providers.retryUnavailable.description: Provider Setup error when a user tries to retry an update whose failure is no longer current. Check again and Update are buttons.

service.providers.signInConnections.defaultMessage: {cli} signs in per account: sign in from Settings → Accounts & Connections.
service.providers.signInConnections.description: An error: Provider Setup was asked to sign a coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code") in, but its logins are accounts (Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section).

service.providers.stillLooking.defaultMessage: Combwork is still looking for {cli}. Try again in a moment.
service.providers.stillLooking.description: An error: Combwork hasn't finished finding the coding agent CLI {cli} ("Codex"), so it can't use it yet.

service.providers.stillLookingAll.defaultMessage: Combwork is still looking for the coding agent CLIs. Try again in a moment.
service.providers.stillLookingAll.description: An error: Combwork hasn't finished finding the coding agent CLIs installed (it does when it starts), so it can't choose one yet.

service.providers.stopFirst.defaultMessage: Stop all running {cli} agents before updating it.
service.providers.stopFirst.description: An error updating the coding agent CLI {cli} ("Codex") while agents run it.

service.providers.stoppedBusy.defaultMessage: {seconds, plural, one {it stayed busy for # second} other {it stayed busy for # seconds}}
service.providers.stoppedBusy.description: Why Combwork stopped typing a coding agent CLI's setup keys: it stayed busy for {seconds} seconds. A clause, lower case (it follows "as").

service.providers.stoppedClosed.description: Why Combwork stopped typing a coding agent CLI's setup keys: its terminal closed. A clause, lower case (it follows "as").

service.providers.task.defaultMessage: {task, select, install {{cli} install} update {{cli} update} login {{cli} sign-in} other {{cli} setup}}
service.providers.task.description: A coding agent CLI's task Combwork runs in a terminal, as its notifications name it: {cli} is the CLI ("Codex"), {task} which task (install, update, sign-in, or another setup).

service.providers.taskDone.description: A notification: a coding agent CLI's task ({task}: "Codex install") ended well.

service.providers.taskFailed.description: A notification: a coding agent CLI's task ({task}: "Codex install") ended with the exit code {code}.

service.slots.notPrepared.description: A notice: a card was started in a slot (a worktree Combwork lends to a card or a lane), and Combwork couldn't check out the card's branch there or install its dependencies. {slot} is the slot's name (slot-b), {card} the card's key, {why} git's or the setup's reason, in English.

service.slots.resumeFailed.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't resume {agent}'s conversation in {slot} for {card} (three tries): {why}. Resume {agent} from Sessions, or start it fresh, and Combwork gives it {card}.
service.slots.resumeFailed.description: A notice (HI-1746): a card was started for an agent (its builder) in a slot, and Combwork's resumes of the agent's last conversation there failed three times, so it stopped trying. Once the user resumes the agent, or starts it, Combwork hands it the card. {card} is the card's key, {agent} the agent's name, {slot} the slot's name (slot-b), {why} the last failure's reason, in English.

service.slots.resumeHeld.defaultMessage: Combwork can't give {card} to {agent} yet: {agent}'s conversation in {slot} can't resume now ({why}). Combwork gives it {card} once it can.
service.slots.resumeHeld.description: A notice (HI-1746): a card was started for an agent (its builder) in a slot, and Combwork hasn't handed the card to it yet; the agent's last conversation, in that slot, can't be resumed now, and Combwork never starts a new conversation instead. {card} is the card's key, {agent} the agent's name, {slot} the slot's name (slot-b), {why} the reason, in English.

service.templates.v09.defaultMessage: 1.0 templates don’t pin agents to worktrees, so the Combwork templates take their place. A copy of {n, plural, one {the template} other {the # templates}} is kept with the 0.9 board backup.
service.templates.v09.description: A quiet notice once after the upgrade to Hive 1.0: the {n} agent templates saved in 0.9 aren't used; a copy of each was put in the folder of the board's 0.9 backup. "The Combwork templates" are Combwork's own templates (the Templates view's Combwork group).

service.templates.v09Title.defaultMessage: Your 0.9 agent templates aren’t used in 1.0
service.templates.v09Title.description: A quiet notice's title, once after the upgrade to Hive 1.0: the agent templates saved in 0.9 aren't listed or loaded any more (a copy is kept).

service.transcripts.busy.defaultMessage: This session is being archived or deleted. Try again in a moment.
service.transcripts.busy.description: An error opening a session's conversation in the Sessions tab while it is being archived or deleted.

service.transcripts.exported.description: The line under the title of a conversation exported as Markdown (Sessions tab → Export): {session} says which session it was, {date} when it was exported.

service.transcripts.imageNotKept.defaultMessage: The image is not stored in the transcript
service.transcripts.imageNotKept.description: An error in the Sessions tab: the conversation's file mentions the image but doesn't hold it.

service.transcripts.noImage.description: An error in the Sessions tab: the image asked for isn't in the conversation (any more).

service.transcripts.noTool.description: An error in the Sessions tab: the tool call asked for isn't in the conversation (any more).

service.transcripts.none.defaultMessage: This session has no transcript yet.
service.transcripts.none.description: An error in the Sessions tab: the session's CLI hasn't written its conversation's file yet.

service.workflow.changedMeanwhile.defaultMessage: The workflow options changed meanwhile (in another window, or by the Assistant), so nothing was saved. The section shows them as they are now.
service.workflow.changedMeanwhile.description: Why saving the Workflow section of the Version Control tab was refused: the options changed after the section was read. It reloads them.

service.workflow.closed.defaultMessage: The workspace this card belongs to has closed
service.workflow.closed.description: An error: a change to a card was asked for in a workspace that has since closed, or whose window opened another workspace.

service.workflow.inheritor.defaultMessage: Project {project} inherits these options, and the change would make its options contradict each other:
service.workflow.inheritor.description: Why saving workflow defaults (Settings → Workflow defaults or Settings → Workspace) was refused: a project that inherits them would have contradictory options. The reason follows on its own line. {project} is its name.

service.workflowNotice.blocked.description: A line of a lane's notification: a card (its key, e.g. HI-12) was marked blocked, with the reason given ({reason}, the user's or an agent's own words).

service.workflowNotice.blockedNoReason.description: A line of a lane's notification: a card (its key, e.g. HI-12) was marked blocked.

service.workflowNotice.failed.description: A line of a lane's notification: its reviewer gave a card (its key, e.g. HI-12) a failing verdict, so it goes back to its builder.

service.workflowNotice.forYou.description: A notification's title: a card (its key, e.g. HI-12) waits for the user (an approval, a decision, a question an agent asked). Its body says what.

service.workflowNotice.lane.description: A notification's title: something happened in a lane (Combwork's record of a card loop, a builder and a reviewer taking cards in turn). {lane} is its label, e.g. “B1 / R1 (greetings)”. Its body lists what happened.

service.workflowNotice.mergeDue.defaultMessage: Every card passed review: its merge is due
service.workflowNotice.mergeDue.description: A line of a lane's notification: all of the lane's cards passed review, so its work is ready to be merged.

service.workflowNotice.mergeStalled.description: A line of a lane's notification: every card passed review, but nobody has started merging the work for a while (its builder is idle or stopped).

service.workflowNotice.merging.defaultMessage: {card} is being merged: the lane waits for it
service.workflowNotice.merging.description: A line of a lane's notification: the lane takes one card at a time, and its card (its key, e.g. HI-12) is in the merge queue, so the next card can't start.

service.workflowNotice.notMerged.defaultMessage: {card} passed review: the lane waits for it to be merged
service.workflowNotice.notMerged.description: A line of a lane's notification: the lane takes one card at a time, and its card (its key, e.g. HI-12) passed review but isn't merged yet, so the next card can't start.

service.workflowNotice.stalled.description: A line of a lane's notification: a card (its key, e.g. HI-12) has stalled: nothing has happened on it for a long time, or its agent stopped.

service.workspace.advancedNotHere.defaultMessage: {setting} can't be set for a workspace.
service.workspace.advancedNotHere.description: An error: the advanced setting {setting} (its title, or its id) has no value of its own for a workspace, only for Combwork.

service.workspace.agentGone.description: An error changing an agent's settings: it was removed meanwhile.

service.workspace.badName.defaultMessage: Project names cannot start with "." or contain {chars}
service.workspace.badName.description: An error making a project: a project's name (its folder's) can't start with a dot or hold the characters {chars}, which Windows doesn't allow in a folder's name.

service.workspace.closed.description: An error: the workspace was closed (or the window opened another) while the action was under way.

service.workspace.connectionGone.defaultMessage: The connection chosen for {agent} was removed, or is being removed. Choose another.
service.workspace.connectionGone.description: An error saving an agent (HI-2107): the connection chosen for it ({agent}, the agent's name) was removed from Settings → Accounts & Connections meanwhile.

service.workspace.folderExists.description: An error making a project: the workspace already has a folder called {name}.

service.workspace.holdsOpen.defaultMessage: The workspace {workspace}, open in another window, is inside {folder}. Close it first to open {name} as a workspace.
service.workspace.holdsOpen.description: An error opening a workspace: another Combwork window's workspace {workspace} is inside the folder {folder} (its name: {name}).

service.workspace.insideOpen.defaultMessage: {folder} is inside the workspace {workspace}, which is open in another window. Close that workspace first, or open this folder's projects from there.
service.workspace.insideOpen.description: An error opening a workspace: the folder {folder} is inside {workspace}, the workspace of another Combwork window (a workspace inside another would share its projects).

service.workspace.nameIn.description: Part of the notice that agents of several projects share a name: {name} is the name, {projects} the projects (a list, in the language's way: "alpha and beta").

service.workspace.namesShared.description: A notice's title: agents of several projects share names.

service.workspace.none.description: An error: the action needs a workspace, and none is open in this window.

service.workspace.notFound.description: An error opening a workspace: the folder {folder} is not there.

service.workspace.notProject.defaultMessage: Not a project in the open workspace: {path}
service.workspace.notProject.description: An error: {path} isn't one of the open workspace's projects (a folder in it, not hidden).

service.workspace.notRoot.defaultMessage: Not a project or agent worktree in the open workspace: {path}
service.workspace.notRoot.description: An error: {path} is neither one of the open workspace's projects nor the worktree of one of their agents.

service.workspace.openElsewhere.defaultMessage: {folder} is already open in another window.
service.workspace.openElsewhere.description: An error opening a workspace: the folder {folder} is the workspace of another Combwork window.

service.workspace.platformGitFound.defaultMessage: {project} is a Git repository now. Combwork goes on treating it as a project without version control until you switch it in its Version Control tab.
service.workspace.platformGitFound.description: A notice: someone ran git init in a project Combwork treats as having no version control. Combwork does not switch it by itself: the Version Control tab offers the switch (glossary 2.1: Version Control).

service.workspace.platformInvalid.defaultMessage: {project}'s project.json names a version control Combwork doesn't know (platform: {value}). Until it says "git" or "none", Combwork uses what it finds in the folder.
service.workspace.platformInvalid.description: A notice: the platform setting in the project {project}'s .combwork/project.json is {value}, which is not one Combwork has (only "git" and "none" are: keep them as they are, they are setting values).

service.workspace.platformInvalidTitle.description: A notice's title: the project {project}'s settings file names a version control Combwork doesn't have.

service.workspace.platformOpen.description: A button on the notice that a project's version control changed: shows the project's Version Control tab, where Combwork offers the switch (glossary 2.1).

service.workspace.platformOtherFound.defaultMessage: {vcs} was found in {project}. Combwork doesn't support it yet, and goes on treating the project as a Git project until you switch it to None in its Version Control tab.
service.workspace.platformOtherFound.description: A notice: another version control system ({vcs}: Mercurial, Jujutsu…) was found in a project Combwork treats as a Git project. Combwork does not switch it by itself: the Version Control tab offers the switch to None (glossary 2.1).

service.workspace.platformRepositoryGone.defaultMessage: {project}'s Git repository is gone. Git's rules hold, so its cards can't move on until the repository is back or you switch the project to None in its Version Control tab.
service.workspace.platformRepositoryGone.description: A notice: the .git folder of a project Combwork treats as a Git project was removed or moved. Combwork doesn't switch it by itself: the Version Control tab offers the switch to None (glossary 2.1).

service.workspace.platformSettled.description: What the notice that a project's version control changed says once it no longer applies (HI-2320): the project was switched, or its folder is back as it was. Shown in place of its button.

service.workspace.platformTitle.description: A notice's title: the version control found in the project {project}'s folder is no longer the one Combwork recorded for it.

service.workspace.renameAgent.description: The notice's button: opens the settings of the agent {agent} of the project {project}, to rename it.

service.workspace.sharedNames.defaultMessage: Agent names are unique across the workspace now, so each agent can be told apart. {shared}: they keep working, but rename one of each, e.g. {project}'s {agent} to {suggestion}.
service.workspace.sharedNames.description: A notice: agents of several projects share names from before names were unique. {shared} says which ("R1 is in alpha and beta"); {suggestion} is a free name for the agent {agent} of the project {project}.

service.workspace.stillClosing.defaultMessage: {name} is still closing: wait for it to finish, then try again.
service.workspace.stillClosing.description: An error opening, making or closing a workspace while this window is still closing its workspace {name}.

service.workspace.stillOpening.defaultMessage: {name} is still opening: wait for it to finish, then try again.
service.workspace.stillOpening.description: An error opening, making or closing a workspace while this window is still opening its workspace {name} (bringing its skills up to date, or upgrading it to Hive 1.0).

service.workspace.twoCalled.description: A notice's title: agents of two projects share the name {name}.
